name: frostnip-pirouette-selective-wither-counters
notes: Frostnip Pirouette's [Diao Chan Bonus] cost modifier (activationCostModifierAbilities["x79cuuw5vo:0"], GeneratedMacroCode.php ~9076) reduces its printed 4-reserve cost by 2 when IsDiaoChanBonus($player) is true (same champion patch technique as frostlorn-caress-four-wither-counters -- Diao Chan, Enchantress with Spirit of Water kept in Subcards for WATER unlock), net cost 2. Frostnip Pirouette is seeded directly into hand. cardActivatedAbilities["x79cuuw5vo:0"] (~23003) offers an MZMULTICHOOSE (min 0) of every non-champion object on either field; customDQHandlers["FrostnipPirouetteWitherLoop"] (Custom/CardDQHandlers.php ~5636) puts exactly 1 wither counter on each object actually present in the player's selection. Three eligible objects are seeded: two on the opponent's field (Dungeon Guide, Fluffy Shopkeep) and one Dungeon Guide on the player's OWN field. Only the two opponent objects are included in the MZMULTICHOOSE response ("theirField-1&theirField-2"), leaving the player's own Dungeon Guide unselected -- proving the wither counter lands only on objects the player actually chose, not on every eligible non-champion object on the board.

rulesClauses: [Diao Chan Bonus] This card costs 2 less.
Choose any amount of non-champion objects and put a wither counter on each.
